title: Salvation
definition: Salvation is God's work of rescuing sinners from sin, judgment, and death through Jesus Christ and bringing them into eternal life.
summary: Salvation is by grace, through faith, in Christ alone. It includes forgiveness, reconciliation, new life, adoption, sanctification, and the hope of glory.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the only Savior. Through His life, death, and resurrection, sinners are reconciled to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Salvation is by grace, through faith, in Christ alone. It includes forgiveness, reconciliation, new life, adoption, sanctification, and the hope of glory.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
